name: AI Meeting Note Takers
intro: AI meeting note takers join or record your Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls, write the transcript and send a summary with action items. The real differences are free-plan limits, CRM sync and how much monthly billing costs compared with annual.
buyingTips: Check what the free plan caps: minutes (Otter.ai), AI summaries (Fathom) or AI notes (tl;dv).
Compare annual and monthly prices. Several tools charge 40-80% more on monthly billing.
If you sell, confirm the CRM sync works on the plan you are buying, not only on the top tier.
For health or legal data, look for HIPAA and SSO, which usually sit on Enterprise plans.

faqs.q: Do AI note takers work without a bot joining the call?
faqs.a: Some do. Fathom offers bot-free capture (in beta on Mac) as well as a meeting bot. Most other tools on this list join as a visible bot participant.

useCases.name: HIPAA-Compliant AI Note Takers
useCases.intro: These AI meeting note takers offer a HIPAA option, which matters for healthcare, therapy and any team that records calls with patient data. HIPAA support usually sits on Business or Enterprise plans and needs a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA).
useCases.ruleText: The vendor advertises a HIPAA option (usually on a Business or Enterprise plan).

useCases.name: AI Note Takers with Mobile Apps
useCases.singular: AI note taker with a mobile app
useCases.intro: These AI note takers have native iOS and Android apps, so you can record in-person meetings, review transcripts and share summaries from your phone.

name: Project Management Software
intro: Project management software tracks tasks, owners and deadlines across a team. The main choice is between simple boards (Trello), structured work management (Asana, monday.com), all-in-one workspaces (ClickUp) and docs-first tools (Notion).
buyingTips: Count seats first: monday.com paid plans start at 3 seats, which matters for very small teams.
Check which plan unlocks timeline/Gantt views if you plan by dates.
If your team writes a lot of documentation, a tool with built-in docs saves a second subscription.
Check what AI is included on your plan; AI packaging changed at several vendors in 2026.

faqs.q: Which project management tool is best for a team of two?
faqs.a: Trello, ClickUp and Asana all have free plans that work for two people. monday.com's free plan also covers two seats, but its paid plans start at three seats.

useCases.name: Project Management Software for Small Teams
useCases.singular: project management tool for a small team
useCases.intro: For teams of one to five people, the main costs to avoid are seat minimums and features you will not use. Every tool here can be bought for a single seat, and all have a free plan to start on.
useCases.ruleText: No seat minimum on paid plans (you can buy 1 seat) and a free plan.

name: CRM Software
intro: CRM software stores your contacts, deals and conversations and shows where every sale stands. Entry prices are close together; the real cost difference shows up at mid tiers, in add-ons and in onboarding fees.
buyingTips: Price the tier you will actually need in a year, not the entry tier.
Look for one-time onboarding fees (for example on HubSpot Professional).
Check whether AI features are bundled (Zoho, Freshsales) or sold as add-ons.
Several CRMs have free plans for 2-3 users that are enough to start.

faqs.q: Which CRM is best for a small business?
faqs.a: HubSpot is the easiest free starting point, Zoho CRM gives the most features per dollar, and Freshsales has the lowest entry paid price with phone and email built in.

useCases.name: CRM Software for Small Business
useCases.intro: A small business usually needs contacts, a deal pipeline and email in one place, at a low per-seat price. Every CRM here has a free plan and a paid entry tier of $15 per user per month or less on annual billing.
useCases.ruleText: Has a free plan, and the paid entry tier costs $15/user/month or less on annual billing.

name: Password Managers
intro: Password managers store and autofill your passwords and passkeys, encrypted so the provider cannot read them. Prices moved a lot in early 2026: 1Password and Bitwarden raised prices, Proton Pass cut its price and Dashlane dropped its free plan.
buyingTips: Check the renewal price, not only the first-year promotional price.
If you want to inspect the code or self-host, choose an open-source option (Bitwarden, Proton Pass).
Confirm passkey support on all your devices.
Family plans are usually cheaper than several individual plans.

faqs.q: Is a free password manager safe?
faqs.a: A free plan from a reputable, audited provider such as Bitwarden or Proton Pass uses the same encryption as its paid plans. The paid tiers add features such as file attachments, emergency access and advanced monitoring.

useCases.name: Password Managers for Linux
useCases.intro: Many password managers only offer a browser extension on Linux. Every tool here ships a native Linux app as well as browser extensions.
useCases.ruleText: Has a native Linux desktop app.

useCases.name: Password Managers with Email Aliases
useCases.intro: Email aliases (masked emails) let you sign up for sites without giving out your real address. These password managers create and store aliases alongside your logins.
useCases.ruleText: Includes email aliases or email masking.
